policy_title: End 'woke' policing and reform police oversight
stated: Reform UK will scrap all Diversity, Equality and Inclusion (DE&I) roles and regulations to stop 'two-tier policing' and overhaul the Independent Office of Police Conduct (IOPC) to make the police complaints system more accountable to the public.

source.quote: Common Sense Policing not ‘Woke’ Policing Scrap all Diversity, Equality and Inclusion (DE&I) roles and regulations to stop two-tier policing. Overhaul the Independent Office of Police Conduct (IOPC) so that the police complaints system becomes more accountable and works for the law-abiding public.

bearing_set.reason: Directly restructures policing practice and the IOPC oversight/complaints mechanism, affecting police accountability, community trust in law enforcement, and the justice system's functioning.

Scrapping DE&I roles and regulations in policing removes formal anti-discrimination and equal-treatment protections; IOPC overhaul alters due-process mechanisms for complainants — both are squarely within the equal-treatment and rule-of-law indicators of O9.

membership_note: Two clear bearings: the IOPC reform element maps onto O5 (justice-system accountability) and the DE&I abolition element maps onto O9 (equal treatment/anti-discrimination protections in policing). O10 was considered — a more accountable complaints body could reduce arbitrary coercion — but the mechanism is indirect and the policy adds no new coercive powers, keeping any liberty effect below the non-negligible bar. O15 (community cohesion/social trust) was considered but judged too indirect without a pinned indicator-level mechanism beyond the policy's own political framing.
